summary: A fresh leg lower in the afternoon has pushed the Nifty to about 22,800, a new session low, with the Sensex down about 1,000 points and broad selling showing no let-up into the last hour.

detail.leaders: Barely any; IT only mildly lower
detail.laggards: Reliance (52-week low), Kotak, HDFC Bank, Bajaj Finance (~−2% each); Hindalco, Max Healthcare; mid- and smallcaps
detail.tone: Worse than 14:00: after holding 22,841 (−1.29%) at 2 pm, the Nifty has slipped to test 22,800, below the morning low of 22,819.65. Heavyweight selling in Reliance and the big banks is driving the new leg down.
watch: A close below 22,800 would mean a fresh six-month closing low

src.title: Business Standard — Stock Market LIVE, Sept 28

top.title: Reliance hits a 52-week low
top.line: Down up to 1.7% to ₹1,205, below its prior 52-week low of ₹1,208.20; −22% so far in 2026
more: The Sensex is down about 13% YTD, so RIL is lagging the market
June-quarter interest costs rose 26.6% to ₹8,337 cr; profit is down 8.3% over a year
It trades below all key moving averages

top.title: A-One Steels closes ~3x, but QIBs stayed out
top.line: ~3x on NII (5.62x) and retail (3.44x) demand; QIBs bid 0x across all three days
more: Allotment is due Sept 29; listing Oct 1 on NSE and BSE
No institutional demand could cap listing-day support

top.title: RBI holds the rupee just short of 96
top.line: The rupee is at 95.95/$ as the RBI repeatedly steps in to stop a sustained break past 96
more: Brent near $107 and the US 10-yr at 5.2% keep pressure on the currency
A break of 96 would be a fresh test of RBI resolve
